records.title: HW-GPT-Bench: Hardware-Aware Architecture Benchmark for Language Models
records.reason: The benchmark is directly relevant to inference hardware trade-offs, but detailed methodology, validation, and limitations remain unverified because the primary paper body could not be read.

records.title: The Integration of Semantic and Structural Knowledge in Knowledge Graph Entity Typing
records.reason: The paper addresses knowledge-graph entity typing using semantic and structural knowledge, not language-model inference efficiency.

records.title: Fine-Grained Modeling of Narrative Context: A Coherence Perspective via Retrospective Questions
records.reason: The contribution is narrative-context coherence modeling/evaluation, with no LLM-serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Long-Horizon Dialogue Understanding for Role Identification in the Game of Avalon with Large Language Models
records.reason: The work evaluates long-horizon dialogue role identification in Avalon using LLMs; its contribution is task performance/evaluation rather than serving efficiency.

records.title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
records.reason: ELF develops continuous diffusion/flow models for data generation; the abstract does not establish an LLM inference-optimization contribution.
